title: Persona-Segment Mappings Schema
description: Schema for many-to-many relationships between personas and non-geographic segments

persona_name.description: Name of the persona - must match an existing Persona.name

segment_category.description: Segment category - must match an existing Segment.category

segment_vector.description: Segment dimension - must match an existing Segment.vector

segment_value.description: Segment value - must match an existing Segment.value

order_index.description: Display order within the persona (lower = earlier)
